notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 regional object publication, subscription, discovery, update, value-request, and region-reassociation surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador/FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and any logical-time implementation. It verifies regional overlap filtering, conveyed source-region designators, named registration, ordinary Update/Reflect metadata, Request Attribute Value Update callbacks, and source-region reassociation without provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador regional object publication, subscription, registration, update, value-request, association, unsubscription, and unpublication services with FederateAmbassador discovery, value-request, and reflection callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador regional object update declarations
